businessRules: Submitting the Add Competency form twice in quick succession (double-click Save) must not create two competency records for the same department/goal.
A Competency's Status must only move between valid states (Not Started -> In progress -> Completed) and must not silently allow an invalid backward or skipped transition.

Each role's permitted and forbidden Competency actions (RM: view-only; TM/EM/Admin: add/edit/delete) must be enforced at both UI level (controls hidden/disabled) and API level (403 on unauthorized write).
Deleting a Competency must present a confirmation dialog before executing, and dismissing/cancelling that dialog must leave the competency unchanged in the listing.
After adding, editing, or deleting a Competency, the Competencies Listing must reflect the change immediately without requiring a manual page refresh.
edgeCases: Competency with 0 targeted members displayed in listing
Competency with 0% progress because no employees have started the linked goal
Department has no goals defined — Goal dropdown in Add Competency is empty, blocking competency creation
Progress average calculation when the linked goal has zero employees currently assigned/progressing (potential divide-by-zero)
Switching the selected Department after partially filling the Add Competency form — verify Goal and other dependent fields reset and re-disable correctly
Description left blank (optional field) — listing renders without error for a competency with no description
Targeted Members = 'All' vs 'Selected' — No of Employees value display/behavior differs depending on which option is chosen
TM/EM/Admin managing multiple departments switches between departments repeatedly — competency listing and Add Competency form state must not leak between departments
Click Save on Add Competency twice in quick succession — verify only one competency record is created for that department/goal combination
Attempt every invalid Status transition (e.g. Completed -> Not Started, or skipping In progress) via the Edit Competency form and verify it is rejected or requires explicit confirmation
Use an RM session to attempt every write action available to TM/EM/Admin (add, edit, delete Competency) via both UI and direct API call — verify both are blocked
Trigger Delete Competency and verify a confirmation dialog appears; cancel it and verify the competency remains unchanged in the listing
Add, edit, and delete a Competency in sequence and verify the listing updates after each action without a manual page refresh (no F5 between steps)
